display.label: Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS)
display.description: Fully managed Kubernetes cluster with auto-scaling node pools, advanced networking, Workload Identity, and enterprise security.

resource.key_description: The unique name for the Azure Kubernetes Service Managed Cluster. Serves as the map key.

sections.label: Basic Configuration
sections.description: Cluster identity, region, and control plane settings.

fields.label: Cluster Name
fields.description: Name of the Managed Kubernetes Cluster. Must begin and end with an alphanumeric character and contain only letters, numbers, and hyphens.

validation.pattern_error: Name must be 1 to 63 characters, start and end with an alphanumeric character, and contain only letters, numbers, and hyphens.

fields.label: Resource Group Name
fields.description: The name of the Resource Group in which to create the Kubernetes Cluster.

fields.label: Region
fields.description: The Azure Region where the Kubernetes Cluster should be created.

fields.label: SKU Tier
fields.description: The SKU Tier for this cluster. Standard includes financially-backed 99.95% uptime SLA.

fields.label: Kubernetes Version
fields.description: Specific Kubernetes control plane version (leave empty for Azure default).

fields.label: Automatic Upgrade Channel
fields.description: Cluster upgrade channel for automated patch and minor version management.

options.label: patch (Keep on latest patch of current minor)
rapid (Upgrade to latest supported minor version)
stable (Upgrade to latest minor N-1 version)

sections.label: Default System Node Pool
sections.description: Primary node pool hosting critical system pods and cluster controllers.

fields.label: System Node Pool Configuration
fields.description: Sizing and auto-scaling settings for the system node pool.

fields.label: Node Pool Name
fields.description: Unique name of the system node pool (1-12 lowercase letters/numbers).

fields.label: VM SKU Size
fields.description: Virtual machine size for the nodes.

fields.label: Enable Autoscaling
fields.description: Enable Kubernetes cluster autoscaler on the system node pool.

fields.label: Minimum Node Count
fields.description: Minimum number of nodes in system pool when autoscaling is enabled.

fields.label: Maximum Node Count
fields.description: Maximum number of nodes in system pool when autoscaling is enabled.

fields.label: OS Disk Size (GB)
fields.description: Size of the OS disk in gigabytes.

fields.label: Subnet Resource ID
fields.description: Subnet ID for custom VNet Azure CNI integration (optional).

sections.label: Networking & Ingress
sections.description: CNI network plugin, network policies, and private cluster configuration.

fields.label: Networking Profile
fields.description: Container Network Interface (CNI) and load balancer parameters.

fields.label: Network Plugin
fields.description: Network plugin used for building Kubernetes network.

fields.label: Network Policy Engine
fields.description: Network policy engine used for traffic filtering between pods.

fields.label: Load Balancer SKU
fields.description: SKU of the Azure Load Balancer used by the cluster.

fields.label: Outbound Routing Type
fields.description: Outbound routing method used for egress traffic.

fields.label: Private Cluster
fields.description: Disable public internet endpoint for the Kubernetes API server.

fields.label: Private DNS Zone ID
fields.description: Private DNS Zone resource ID for private cluster FQDN resolution (or 'System').

sections.label: Security & Workload Identity
sections.description: Identity, Microsoft Entra ID, and governance features.

fields.label: Managed Identity Type
fields.description: Managed identity type assigned to the AKS cluster control plane.

fields.label: Enable OIDC Issuer
fields.description: Enable OIDC discovery endpoint required for Microsoft Entra Workload Identity.

fields.label: Enable Workload Identity
fields.description: Enable Microsoft Entra Workload Identity for passwordless Azure service access.

fields.label: Enable Azure Policy Add-on
fields.description: Enforce built-in Azure Policy controls and compliance on cluster workloads.

fields.label: Disable Local Admin Accounts
fields.description: Enforce Entra ID authentication and disable local cluster-admin kubeconfig access.

fields.label: Log Analytics Workspace ID
fields.description: Resource ID of the Log Analytics Workspace for Container Insights monitoring.

sections.label: Additional Node Pools
sections.description: Map of secondary worker node pools (spot instances, GPU nodes, or dedicated user pools).

fields.label: Worker Node Pools
fields.description: Map of secondary worker node pool configurations.

sections.label: Tags
sections.description: Resource tags for governance and cost tracking.

fields.label: Resource Tags
fields.description: Key-value pairs to assign to the AKS Cluster.
